models.method: Justin independent scenario. Revenue=sum quarterly revenue; Q1 actual228, other quarters assumed. Bear delays acceptance to April; base February ramp; bull January ramp with additional output. Gross profit=revenue*gross_margin_ex_da; EBITDA=gross_profit-cash_opex_ex_sbc (adjusted proxy excluding SBC, not GAAP EBITDA). Net income proxy=EBITDA-D&A-SBC-net_interest-cash_tax; no fair-value gains assumed. FCF proxy=EBITDA-net_interest-cash_tax-capex-working_capital_cash_use, before customer prepayments/new financing/debt principal; not GAAP CFO-capex. Capex=4824 actual Q1 PPE/hardware +15000 remaining issuer plan. Annual margins are author blends, not issuer targets. COMPARABILITY OVERRIDE: metrics.gross_profit deducts ALL modeled D&A analytically; supplemental gross_profit_before_da retains pre-D&A contribution. metrics.ebitda includes SBC: adjusted_ebitda_proxy minus stock_compensation. Valuation uses separately labeled adjusted proxy. metrics.fcf is null: supplemental cash_flow_before_customer_financing_and_prepaid_revenue_adjustment lacks new customer prepayments and subtraction of revenue previously prepaid. It is not CFO minus capex or distributable cash. Net income remains adjusted EBITDA minus D&A, SBC, net interest and taxes.

valuation.capital_basis: Debt, cash,500M other-claims buffer and500/550/650M diluted shares are explicit future sensitivities, not sourced forecasts. Financing rollforward is unresolved; no scenario probability or weighted target.
valuation.method: EV=FY2028 adjusted EBITDA*multiple; common equity=max(0,EV-assumed debt-finance leases + unrestricted cash - other claims); price=common equity/assumed diluted shares. Debt field already includes finance leases: subtract once.
valuation.multiple_basis: Author6/8/10x scenarios, not observed peer multiples. Lower multiple reflects replacement capex/contract runoff and execution risk; upper requires durable utilization and refinancing. EBITDA capitalizes neither full GPU replacement nor contracted debt service: cross-check negative FCF. Standardized EBITDA in model metrics includes SBC; scenario multiples here are on separately disclosed adjusted EBITDA only.

reverse.method: (price*assumed shares + debt16000 - cash1500 + claims500)/8; author capital basis, not market consensus.
